Chapter 730 - 730 Situation; Energy Tsunami!

Chapter 730 - 730 Situation; Energy Tsunami!

730 Situation; Energy Tsunami!

The cultivation lecture at the Coiling Dragon Villa lasted for half a month before it slowly came to an end.

Hu Tian, Su Ningjing, Xia Bing, Xia Xue, Qin Menghu, Zheng Cong, Song Wenxuan, and Riemann all looked enlightened.

The aura around them was obviously stronger than half a month ago.

Lin Fan ate a sumptuous meal with everyone before returning to his room.

He did not immediately enter a state of cultivation. Instead, he used the soul communication technique on Ma Zheng.

“Ma Zheng!”

After a while, Ma Zheng said respectfully,””Greetings, Master.”

“How are you now?” Lin Fan asked.

“Master, I recently became an elder of the Raincloud Altar.”Ma Zheng said.

The person with the highest status in the Raincloud Sanctum was undoubtedly the Sanctum Leader, followed by the Deputy Sanctum Leader, the First Elder, and the Second Elder. There were also many ordinary elders.

In other words, Ma Zheng was now one of the true upper echelons of the Raincloud Sanctum.

This only took a short hundred years.

It had to be said that this rate of advancement was truly astonishing.

Lin Fan nodded,” Not bad.”

When Ma Zheng heard this, a hint of joy appeared on his face.

If his master praised him, that would be the greatest reward for him.

Lin Fan asked,” How’s the battle between the Ocean Universe and the Four Seasons Universe?”

” The Ocean Universe has completely occupied the Summer Region,” Ma Zheng said.” Now, they are attacking the Spring Region. It is said that a small part of the Spring Region has already been conquered.”

” In addition, some people say that Four Seasons Universe wants to give up on Spring Territory and focus more power on defending Autumn Territory and Winter Territory. Then, they’ll quietly wait for the return of Four Seasons Universe Master.”

“There are also people who say that the Four Seasons Universe is preparing to gather a powerful force somewhere in the Spring Field to launch a surprise attack on the ocean universe.”

“But no matter what, the Spring Region is in great danger. Thus, our Raincloud Sanctum withdrew from the Spring Region.”

When Ma Zheng said this, his tone could not help but have a deep sigh.

He was a member of the Four Seasons Universe.

All along, he had thought that the Four Seasons Universe was the strongest and most stable, and would never be attacked.

However, the world was unpredictable.

Lin Fan nodded. Then, he guided Ma Zheng on his cultivation. This was one of the reasons why Ma Zheng was able to raise his status in the Raincloud Sanctum so quickly.

This was because this was a world where the strong reigned supreme.

After ending the soul connection, Lin Fan entered his cultivation state.

As for what kind of attack the ocean universe would launch against the Four Seasons Universe, he wasn’t too concerned.

After all, he was not from the Four Seasons Universe.

As long as the other party did not provoke him, it would be fine.

However, things always went against his wishes.

Lin Fan had only cultivated for a few days…

“Boom!”

There was a dull sound.

The entire earth shook.

Lin Fan opened his eyes slowly and looked up into the void.

He saw…

Three pitch-black battleships the size of miniature moons appeared in the void.

A scarlet ‘X’ was drawn on the bottom of the three warships, which looked very hideous and creepy.

This… They were the three X-series battleships of the ocean universe.

Under the observation of the Eyes of Heaven, the X-series warship and everyone in it were full of weaknesses.

When Lin Fan saw this, he took a step forward.

….

At this moment, inside the X201 warship.

The shark-headed man said viciously,” This planet isn’t simple. It actually blocked one of my energy cannons!”

The energy cannons on the X-series warships could easily destroy a star.

But now, it did not cause any damage to a planet.

This was definitely abnormal.

Inside the X301 warship.

The man with the octopus head said,” There is no data of an unknown disaster detected around this planet. C108 should have been destroyed by the creatures on the planet. Report the situation back first.””

As soon as it finished speaking, its several tentacles quickly jumped on the keyboard.

After a while, a document with pictures and text was sent out.

Inside the X401 warship.

The man with the sea lion head said,”An energy cannon is useless?” Where are the Storm Energy Bullets?”

He did as he was told.

He pressed many buttons with both hands.

“Xiu! Whoosh! Whoosh!”

In the next moment…

Dense energy bombs bombarded Earth from all directions like a storm.

“Whoosh!”

It was also at this moment that a tall and handsome figure appeared in the void.

It was Lin Fan.

He saw…

Lin Fan raised his palm as starlight surrounded him.

Then, a huge palm that covered the sky appeared in the sky.

” Universe in a Palm!”

In an instant, all the energy cannons sank into the huge palm and seemed to transform into starlight, emitting a dazzling light.

“Impossible!” Everyone in the X201, X301, and X401 warships screamed in horror.

One had to know…

Storm energy bombs, there were a lot of them, each of them could threaten domain lord level warriors.

However, the person in front of him…However, with a flip of his hand, he easily blocked all the energy bombs.

Just how strong was he?

The three men with the heads of a shark, an octopus, and a sea lion said solemnly,”” An unknown expert has been discovered. He might be the one who destroyed starship C108. Be careful!”

” Entering level one combat readiness!”

“Beep!”

The three battleships let out a soft sound.

Clearly, they were all extremely wary of Lin Fan.

When the octopus-headed man gave the order, several claws jumped on the keyboard again.

After giving the order, he sent a document to the captain.

“Prepare the Triple Tsunami Energy Cannon!” the shark-headed man said.

“Agreed!” the man with the octopus head said.

“Agreed!” the sea lion head man said.

The three X-series warships suddenly stacked together, turning into a huge triangular warship.

Then, the three battleships continuously gathered their energy toward the center, forming countless twisting electric snakes.

These electric snakes quickly condensed and turned into an energy ball that was as dazzling as the sun.

“Fire!”

Instantly, the energy ball started to churn. It was like a tsunami of energy that could destroy the world as it headed towards Lin Fan.

The tsunami energy cannon was the most powerful attack of an X-series warship.

An X-series battleship’s tsunami energy cannon could kill universe level warriors.

The Triple Tsunami Energy Cannon was an energy cannon fired by three X-series warships. Even a King class expert would be heavily injured if hit head-on.

“Roar!”

The terrifying energy tsunami vaguely emitted the roar of an ancient beast, causing the entire space to tremble violently. It had endless power.

Regarding this…

Lin Fan just waved his palm.

” Universe in a Palm!”

It covered the sky.

No matter how strong and big the ancient beast was, it was still a living being in the universe. It could never destroy the universe or break free from it.

The palm landed and instantly covered the energy tsunami, turning it into wisps of starlight and disappearing in an instant.

“What?” Everyone in the three X-series warships let out a cry of horror again.

And this…It was their last voice.
